note: Forbidden behaviour (SHOULD): a default window other than 64. TestChildSAReplayWindowDefault asserts ReplayWin == 64 on both IKE Child SAs with no window configured; any other default goes red. Single-polarity marker present. The OSPFv3 manual path defaults to no anti-replay, which RFC 4303 Section 3.3.3 advises for manually keyed SAs, so the default-window sentence binds the IKE path.
